QUOTE: "`LlamaCppTokenizer::tokenize` returns `{}`. The only signal is one `logger->error` line (line 65). ... Nothing propagates an error code." and "`count_tokens` ... return `0` too. A caller doing budget math sees "zero tokens" and thinks the prompt fits."
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer says failure returns an empty vector with no error code and that most callers don't check, but it also reports that some callers do check (the `tokens.size() < 2` guards). It never says failure is indistinguishable from a legitimately empty result, and it never says no caller checks.
